description: Drainage - Outlet Components is a dataset listed in Pierce County open data portal (internal.open.piercecountywa.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by Pierce County. GPS'd storm water point features in unincorporated Pierce County related to the outlet of another feature, such as quarry spalls, debris barriers, etc. Includes public and private features except where private gates prevent access. Please read metadata ( for additional information. Any data download constitutes acceptance of the Terms of Use (. Coverage: Pierce County, Washington. The portal files it under the category Maps and Geospatial. Its tags are outlet components, drainage. The table has 39 columns. The portal shows 2026-07-02 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-internal-open-piercecountywa-gov-portal.
